principles. Reference code {{TOKEN}}.

1. CEO review - is this worth building at all?
2. Design review - does the shape fit the product?

fm-04-gateway-without-connection.title: a gateway tool committed without its connection
fm-04-gateway-without-connection.prompt_note: discover -> connect -> commit is a three-step flow, and the middle step is the one a model skips: the tool entry commits fine, the config LOOKS wired, and the first real call fails. Needs discover_tools and list_connections mounted, and a deployment with a gateway provider; it SKIPs loudly otherwise, because a skip here is an untested claim and not a pass.

fm-05-recovery-from-correctable-refusal.title: recover from a correctable refusal in one more call
fm-05-recovery-from-correctable-refusal.prompt_note: The seeded document says the same sentence twice, so the obvious anchor is ambiguous and earns `text_not_unique`, whose next step is 'add more surrounding lines until it appears once'. One-shot recovery means the model follows that and succeeds on the next call. The global identical-repeat instrument is what catches the opposite behavior: re-sending the same bytes because `retryable` said so.
